name: uBlock Origin (test stand-in)
description: A fixture for test/e2e/ublock-origin.js and test/units/ublock-origin-units.js: a Manifest V2 background page that, as uBlock Origin does, uses `browser` when there is one (browserAction at start-up) and blocks /standin-ad.js with a blocking webRequest listener, but only for a request that comes with its tab (uBlock lets requests with tabId -1 through).
